review_text: We discovered this restaurant after two days and came here for breakfast four days in a row because the food is so good. The staff is very friendly, and the dishes are offered at a fair price.

address: 171B Đ. Cống Quỳnh, Cầu Ông Lãnh, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: We‘ve been here 3 times in the last 5 days. The food is really delicious and quite cheap. The staff is also friendly and quick. As soon as you sit down, they will come to you and bring you the menu. We couldn‘t be happier with this restaurant. I‘m also very happy that there are so many options. The last time I had braised tofu with mushrooms and rice and one iced tea. It was so good! Definitely worth a visit :)

address: 424 Lê Quang Định, Bình Lợi Trung, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Good place to take Ma out to eat chay vegetarian food after visiting Chua Duoc Su Temple. She loved Vuon Chay and gave it two 👍🏽👍🏽. Lotus rice might not come as pictured in the leaf. Vit Quay Banh Bao was interesting and delicious. It’s the one with the little donuts type bread. Staff was friendly and helpful. Owner speaks English. Nice large outdoor seating area. Restrooms are upstairs but Mother got up there with a guide. Place was clean and tidy. Taxi could get all the way to the location. Recommended 👍🏽👍🏽

address: 424 Lê Quang Định, Bình Lợi Trung, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Very cozy place! Delicious food, mid-range prices for veggie food, friendly stuff!

address: 424 Lê Quang Định, Bình Lợi Trung, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: The food is so-so, but the waiting time is too long, I'd eaten a half way through then my drink came out.

address: 424 Lê Quang Định, Bình Lợi Trung, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: The restaurant is clean. Taste is good. Price is reasonable.

address: 424 Lê Quang Định, Bình Lợi Trung, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Very well done. Upon entering we were meet with the wonderful scent of lemon grass. Reminding us of our big Saigon garden. Professional staff, pleasant atmosphere, cool & comfortable. Relaxed dinning with much room between the tables. Complimentary wifi. At this time the upper level is being completed. Quite enjoyable, great food and drinks. The price was reasonable. We will bring friends next time. Thank you. We have been back a few times. Last time they seen to have enhanced the deco and made some tasty changes to the menu and flavors.

address: ĐỐI DIỆN 100, Thiên Phước, Phú Thọ, Hồ Chí Minh 700000, Việt Nam
review_text: This place for Vegan and whose loves eating healthy🥗🌿🌿🌿 Drinks and foods was good. Kindly service. We sometime come here for lunch and dinner. Thank you so much.🌹 Peace to everyone.🙏

review_text: We visited the restaurant twice, and the meal for one person cost 80k VND. I can confirm it was delicious. They refilled the dishes as soon as they ran out, and the vegetables looked very fresh. They also have tea. Overall, I really liked it and will definitely visit again. 8.5/10

review_text: This vegetarian restaurant is delicious and clean. They serve a wide variety of dishes. The lunch buffet is only 50k/person, 30k/person for children, and includes complimentary jelly dessert and 7 different flavored drinks. In the afternoon, they offer a hot pot buffet for 80k/adult and 40k/child with 4 broth options and unlimited toppings, mostly green vegetables. Considering the price, the quality and hygiene are excellent. My family often visits and supports them. Everyone should give it a try!

restaurant_name: Lẩu bò Nhà gỗ - Sài Gòn
address: 162 Lý Thái Tổ, Bàn Cờ, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Popular shop for hot pot Date of visit: June 2025 The tables are low, and you sit on stools. You order on the tablet, which is in Vietnamese. The servers didn't really speak English. I didn't know how to eat what I ordered, so they were very nice and showed me how to cook and wrap the veggies with the rice paper. I had a very enjoyable meal. The food was so good. For two people, we spent 448k VND and we took home the leftovers! It was raining outside during the meal, and I felt cozy while inside.

restaurant_name: Lẩu bò Nhà gỗ - Sài Gòn
address: 162 Lý Thái Tổ, Bàn Cờ, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Super delicious beef hotpot. They even have these wraps as well that was super delicious. The top floor was a bit sketchy, the floors would shake and feel like we were gonna fall through when someone walked by. But we made it out alive, so it's all good. Overall, food was good.

restaurant_name: Lẩu bò Nhà gỗ - Sài Gòn
address: 162 Lý Thái Tổ, Bàn Cờ, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: The restaurant looks like for a local. They served the soup with tons of veggie. The soup is a bit sweet but very nice. All the beef inside is very good!! I also order a meatball, quite good.

restaurant_name: Lẩu bò Nhà gỗ - Sài Gòn
address: 162 Lý Thái Tổ, Bàn Cờ, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Perfect place for the beef hotpot. The pot consist of different parts of the beef meat. From the brisket, tenderloin to the trotter. The pork trotter skin is well braised as it’s so tender and soft. The soup is very prepared as it’s sweet and nice to have. Chilli sauce can be really spicy. Hotpot for 2 only has small and large to choose from. The portioning is good. Very crowded and a lot of locals coming over for food.

restaurant_name: Lẩu bò Nhà gỗ - Sài Gòn
address: 162 Lý Thái Tổ, Bàn Cờ, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: The food is delicious, the taste of the broth soup was fresh but not much beef meat added. Average price of 250k dong for 2 people. Recommend 👍

address: 288 M1, 288J1 Nam Kỳ Khởi Nghĩa, Ward 8, Xuân Hòa, Hồ Chí Minh 700000, Việt Nam
review_text: I wouldn’t recommend this place. At 100k, it feels overpriced compared to other options in Vietnam. It used to be a spot my parents loved, but on my recent visit it seems to have lost its touch. The portion was small and the broth was bland. The meat looked pale and didn’t seem very fresh or high quality. They also served a large bowl of onions on the side instead of a more balanced set of toppings. Very disappointing for pho.

address: 288 M1, 288J1 Nam Kỳ Khởi Nghĩa, Ward 8, Xuân Hòa, Hồ Chí Minh 700000, Việt Nam
review_text: Dig into these bowls on a light, rainy morning with my partner. This place is located in a big alley. The establishment isn't so big, but there are a lot of seats around the store, outdoor and indoor. About the bowl, the broth is okay but didn't meet my taste, however, the well-done and crispy beef flanks are delicious. They also serve a small bowl of sliced onion; you can mix it with the formula on the table and eat it together with the beef. This place is popular, but you don't have to wait too long to get your food.

address: 288 M1, 288J1 Nam Kỳ Khởi Nghĩa, Ward 8, Xuân Hòa, Hồ Chí Minh 700000, Việt Nam
review_text: Pho Dau is very different with other pho places in HCM. People who try it 1st time, may not like it. But after few times, you just keep coming back... Super good 👍👍

address: 288 M1, 288J1 Nam Kỳ Khởi Nghĩa, Ward 8, Xuân Hòa, Hồ Chí Minh 700000, Việt Nam
review_text: Phở Dậu – Classic northern-style phở in Saigon. Clear, naturally sweet broth, tender beef, and simple traditional flavor. No-frills space but quality is excellent. A must-try if you love authentic, old-school phở. ⭐️ 8.5/10

address: 288 M1, 288J1 Nam Kỳ Khởi Nghĩa, Ward 8, Xuân Hòa, Hồ Chí Minh 700000, Việt Nam
review_text: It's Phở restaurant, which is from year 1958. It's one of the oldest Pho restaurant in HCMC. Probably the 3rd oldest? Pho Minh, Pho Le, then may be this shop. Then it's very popular, so many people were coming even though it's not cheap. The Pho itself was really good with sliced onion. It tastes new to me as Pho. The combination was really good. As Pho, It may be one of the best Pho in HCMC, but the price is a bit high...actually similar price to the other Michelin selected shops. I think it could be selected though.

restaurant_name: Phở KHÔI NGUYÊN - Phở Ngon Quận 5
address: 83 Đ. Huỳnh Mẫn Đạt, An Đông, Hồ Chí Minh 70000, Việt Nam
review_text: The place and staff seem well organized, and I like the way they prepare the ingredients and handle the whole soup-making process. The broth is a bit too sweet for my personal taste, though I know many locals enjoy a sweeter broth. The meat is of good quality and served in a decent portion. The noodles were slightly too soft and a bit overcooked for my preference. All in all, a good pho option, and I will surely come back.

restaurant_name: Phở KHÔI NGUYÊN - Phở Ngon Quận 5
address: 83 Đ. Huỳnh Mẫn Đạt, An Đông, Hồ Chí Minh 70000, Việt Nam
review_text: Atmosphere, I went at 6pm. There were only two other tables there. But soon, more arrived. And food delivery guys came and went. There are tables street side and tables within the open concept restaurant. Service, I wasn't sure how to order what I wanted. So I showed a pic from previous customer. I learned later that what I wanted to order was Pho Suon Bo Cong, beef rib pho, 95k. Instead, the guy kept up selling me for the Dac Biet, 135k. I showed him the picture again, and asked as it didn't look like the Dac Biet. But he kept nodding his head. So I ordered the Dac Biet. Food: the broth was beefy and had good umami. The beef rib had tons of meat and was cooked til it fell off the bone. There were other slices of pork meat, braised pork belly, tendon/cartilage, etc.. It was a lot of meat. I'm guessing they're trying to justify the 135k. If it's just for one person, I suggest to order the pho Suon Bo Cong. 95k. It's more than enough meat for one person. Overall, it was a good bowl of noodles. But I wish the staff was more honest. Dac Biet, 135k. Napkins extra. Drinks extra.

restaurant_name: Phở KHÔI NGUYÊN - Phở Ngon Quận 5
address: 83 Đ. Huỳnh Mẫn Đạt, An Đông, Hồ Chí Minh 70000, Việt Nam
review_text: Great spot in district 5, one of the best Pho’s I’ve had here in HCMC, tasty and savory broth, fresh greens and sprouts, in an out of the way spot, check it out, well worth it 👏🤩👍😎

restaurant_name: Phở KHÔI NGUYÊN - Phở Ngon Quận 5
address: 83 Đ. Huỳnh Mẫn Đạt, An Đông, Hồ Chí Minh 70000, Việt Nam
review_text: Ordered delivery and good was piping hot and packaged well. Pho is delicious, and the broth is clean. A little pricey for vietnam standards but worth it. Meats are good quality and tender, and the veggies are fresh and clean. I will order again soon.

restaurant_name: Phở KHÔI NGUYÊN - Phở Ngon Quận 5
address: 83 Đ. Huỳnh Mẫn Đạt, An Đông, Hồ Chí Minh 70000, Việt Nam
review_text: Superb. Very umami beef soup base. The beef is fresh look at the bone in my picture it’s “bone white” no frozen freezer burn. And a little fatty which makes its way into the soup making it even more rich. Fresh herbs 🌿 to add to soup is icing on cake. Eat here. You will have zero regrets.

address: 30E Hồ Hảo Hớn, Cầu Ông Lãnh, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Came here this morning for a Pho as I was staying just behind it. WOW! I've travelled from the North of Vietnam all the way down to Saigon and can genuinely say this is the best bowl of Pho I've ever had. The broth was unbelievably good. They close around 10.30am though so get there early! Also, the staff who work there are lovely 🩷

address: 30E Hồ Hảo Hớn, Cầu Ông Lãnh, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Super tender meat and a rich, savory broth. So good! The medium size is actually a massive portion. Plus, the orange juice is freshly squeezed—highly recommend!

address: 30E Hồ Hảo Hớn, Cầu Ông Lãnh, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: This has to be right up there with one of the best bowl’s of pho I have ever had! It is on the richer and more seasoned side which i prefer over the clean, mild broths. Unfortunately it only opens during the day so have to get it for breakfast.

address: 30E Hồ Hảo Hớn, Cầu Ông Lãnh, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Delicious bowl of Pho. Ladies were attentive and friendly to all customers. No price visible anywhere including on the menu. We ordered 2 bowls of Pho with medium rare beef, flank, brisket and tendon, they were 100k each bowl. A bit pricey as we could easily get a good bowl of pho for 50k everywhere in Ho Chi Minh city but overall we enjoyed our experience at Pho Ngoc

address: 30E Hồ Hảo Hớn, Cầu Ông Lãnh, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Honestly, SO good 🤤 if you are in the area give it a try. The broth is amazing and we had Pho twice while staying at a Homestay just above. Friendly service, generous portions.

address: 25 Hoàng Sa, Sài Gòn, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Located on Hoàng Sa Street in Sai Gon Ward, Phở Phượng is not only a long-standing pho restaurant but also a Michelin Selected spot, offering a refined Vietnamese dining experience. The highlight here is definitely the broth, clear, naturally sweet from simmered bones, and free from the overly strong sweetness of industrial seasoning. The flavor is rich yet balanced, staying enjoyable until the very last spoonful without becoming overwhelming. The ingredients are also high quality. The beef was fresh and tender, cooked just enough to keep its natural sweetness. The pho noodles were soft while still slightly chewy, not mushy at all. The fresh herbs and vegetables were clean and vibrant, and the satay sauce was especially delicious. Adding a bit of lime and chili really elevated the whole bowl. The price is a little higher compared to regular pho places, but considering the prime District 1 location, clean space, canal-side atmosphere, and Michelin-recognized quality, I think it’s completely worth it. Definitely one of the best pho spots to try in Saigon if you’re looking for a traditional yet polished bowl of pho. However, one downside during my visit was the service. My group of five ordered different bowls with several special requests, such as no spring onion or cilantro for some dishes. The staff didn’t write the orders down and assured us they could remember everything, but when the food arrived, some bowls were incorrect. We had to wait longer for them to fix the orders, which affected the overall experience a bit.

address: 25 Hoàng Sa, Sài Gòn, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Pho Phuong serves a very good bowl of pho with a rich, flavorful broth and fresh ingredients. The beef was tender, the noodles had a nice texture, and the herbs added great freshness. The taste was balanced and comforting without being overly salty. Service was friendly, and the overall dining experience was enjoyable. I would definitely come back again.

address: 25 Hoàng Sa, Sài Gòn, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Great for street side. They even have ac blowers trying to beat the crazy heat. Great pho. Fab clear soup. Oxtail was interesting. Beef rib can be missed. Too chewy. Balls and flank and brisket superb.

address: 25 Hoàng Sa, Sài Gòn, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: My grand parent ate here since they were dating until my generation - grandson. The store is still located there, have some branches, the owner is still the same family and I am happy that they got the 3rd year of Michelin guide. The location is so nice and fresh, they have the shade for either sunny or rainy days. The staffs are friendly and fast service, the price is a bit high but worth the quality around 80k per bowl. The stock is cooked with thick bones so very “bony sweet”. I like this store because it’s nostalgia taste and nice view. My score is 8.5/10. Highly recommended for international friends

address: 25 Hoàng Sa, Sài Gòn, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Pho Phuong in Ho Chi Minh City was genuinely delicious and easy to enjoy. The broth was clean, rich, and well balanced, and the overall bowl felt very refined without losing the comforting, classic pho experience. It was definitely better than most of the pho we get back in Australia, with a fresher taste and a lighter finish. That said, I would not say it was dramatically better to the point that it completely outclassed good pho back home. What really stood out to me was how I felt afterwards. Unlike some soups in Australia that can leave me feeling thirsty or dehydrated, this one did not. It tasted full of flavour without feeling overly heavy or loaded with salt. A very good bowl of pho and well worth trying.

address: 140B Nguyễn Cư Trinh, Cầu Ông Lãnh, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: The pho here was good, with a flavorful broth and satisfying portions. One thing I appreciated was that they also offer chicken pho, which is not always easy to find, as well as fried glass noodles for those looking for something different. The food was enjoyable overall, but I do hope the restaurant considers a bit of renovation and housekeeping. During my visit, there were some visible pieces of paper and food scraps around the premises, which affected the overall dining atmosphere. That said, the pho itself was tasty, and this is still a place worth considering if you’re looking for a good bowl of pho with a few additional menu options.

address: 140B Nguyễn Cư Trinh, Cầu Ông Lãnh, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Delicious and fairly clean. It has AC and fans. Comfortable. Price is fair/affordable.

address: 140B Nguyễn Cư Trinh, Cầu Ông Lãnh, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: The soup is great and quite hot, I love the texture! Will come back soon!

address: 140B Nguyễn Cư Trinh, Cầu Ông Lãnh, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: When you are in HCMC and you want to try Pho, come here. You can find Pho which is traditional serve with good taste

address: 140B Nguyễn Cư Trinh, Cầu Ông Lãnh, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Discovered this place on Google Maps while searching for nearby food near my hotel. I was pleasantly surprised by the delicious broth and quality of meat. The variety of condiments provided was impressive, although I opted for a touch of chili oil and basil in my soup. Overall, the food was fantastic, and the cost was around $2.

address: 21 Hoàng Sa, Sài Gòn, Hồ Chí Minh 710200, Việt Nam
review_text: It's Pho restaurant next to Pho Phuong, which has been selected as Michellin Bibgurment. The behavior of the staffs were not friendly here, but the Pho itself is .... I think better than the one next to it. I just had "Pho Bo", cannot choose the kind of meat... then the result was, mix of "Tay" and "Num". It was really good. The quality of the meat was awsome. I liked the soup also. They have great Hoi Sin and Chili sauce. So it was really great. The price is much cheaper than next shop, so I would select this shop rather than next shop.

address: 21 Hoàng Sa, Sài Gòn, Hồ Chí Minh 710200, Việt Nam
review_text: The Bò Né was exceptional! The owner is really kind. We go here pretty often and he remembers our order. Totally recommended 😊

address: 21 Hoàng Sa, Sài Gòn, Hồ Chí Minh 710200, Việt Nam
review_text: Food was really good and it’s a great spot for people watching. The young guy working there was great—good energy and even put a fan behind me when he saw I was hot. The two girls were the opposite, no engagement, and asking for the bill was a bit like pulling teeth. Overall, good food!

address: 21 Hoàng Sa, Sài Gòn, Hồ Chí Minh 710200, Việt Nam
review_text: This place is incredible. The pho broth is so good that I didn’t want to add any greens or sauces. The beef tendon was simply the best, as was the veal tail.

address: 21 Hoàng Sa, Sài Gòn, Hồ Chí Minh 710200, Việt Nam
review_text: I had a fantastic dining experience at Phở Bê Thanh Đa. If you’re looking for truly delicious phở, this place absolutely delivers. The broth was rich, aromatic, and full of depth — clearly simmered with care and tradition. The beef was tender and perfectly cooked, and the noodles had just the right texture. Every element in the bowl felt balanced and thoughtfully prepared.

address: 61 Hàm Nghi, Sài Gòn, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: If you’re looking for an authentic local experience, Quán Phở Hà is a must-visit! 🍜 Their soup is simply delicious, filled with rich flavors and comforting warmth. A standout dish here is their egg soup 🥚—the perfectly poached eggs swimming in the broth add a unique twist that you won’t want to miss! This spot captures the essence of local dining with simple tables, friendly service, and a no-fuss vibe. Pair your pho with an ice-cold beer 🍺, and you have the perfect combo for a casual meal. It’s one of those hidden gems where you can sit back, slurp away, and soak in the charm of the everyday Saigon dining scene. Highly recommended for anyone wanting to enjoy some delicious pho in a relaxed, local atmosphere! Let me know if you’d like any adjustments or more details! 😊

address: 61 Hàm Nghi, Sài Gòn, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Highlight is the chicken serve in the Pho Ga in Hanoi style. The meat is flavorful. The broth is clear and magical tasty. This shop gives a real local vibes. Remark: they accept cash only & there is no English Menu.

address: 61 Hàm Nghi, Sài Gòn, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Trying to find Phở Gà in Saigon, lucky found nice one. Their Phở Gà very light and healthy. Chicken broth made their soup healthier… I dont really like beef pho,at all 🤪🤪🤪🤪🤪 i do love chicken pho…. Staff very friendly and spacious space, they will open more chair and table outside, alot of people choose to sit outside

address: 61 Hàm Nghi, Sài Gòn, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: This place is as local as it gets. Sitting roadside having a bowl of noodle is definitely a must for me in Vietnam. I got a bowl of noodle alongside with steam chicken thigh, and they were all exceptionally delicious. For you drinkers who stay up late drinking, this place is your go to remedy to wash away that headache. Something worth mentioning, staff and the lady in charge here didn’t speak any English, but they are super nice and helpful. What a lovely place.

address: 61 Hàm Nghi, Sài Gòn, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: A humble Pho noodles shop that’s situated within walking distance to Saigon Central and SkyPark. This place was recommended by a local and after tasting the beef pho, I know why. Their beef is fresh and tender. I was just slurping the noodles which was fine, soft and nice. Soup wise was just average. Good place for a tummy filler to get the Pho noodles soup kick and warmly hugging your tummy.

address: 269A Nguyễn Trãi, Cầu Ông Lãnh, Hồ Chí Minh 700000, Việt Nam
review_text: I visited Phở Hiền Nguyễn Trãi in the morning. It’s located right in District 1, so it’s very convenient to find. The place is clean and has air conditioning, which makes it comfortable, especially during hot days. The pho was generous in portion, with a flavorful and light broth that wasn’t overly salty. The noodles were soft, and the beef was fresh and nicely sliced. Even though the place was quite busy, the service was quick and efficient. The price is reasonable considering the central location and quality. Overall, it’s a solid spot for pho and definitely worth trying when you’re in District 1 👍

address: 269A Nguyễn Trãi, Cầu Ông Lãnh, Hồ Chí Minh 700000, Việt Nam
review_text: Honestly so good. I ordered the small bowl but it was plenty filling. The broth was absolutely delightful. The initial taste was so fresh and pure, but after adding the good goods, it tasted flavorful and strong. The noodles were also great as they weren’t overcooked. Overall, great place with quick service. I’d definitely recommend this place if you’re nearby.

address: 269A Nguyễn Trãi, Cầu Ông Lãnh, Hồ Chí Minh 700000, Việt Nam
review_text: I tried my first pho in Vietnam! The broth was so clean and had a delightful sweet taste that was a bit different from the pho I’m used to in Canada. I was blown away by how tasty it was! I highly recommend this restaurant pho. I’ll definitely be coming back again! The price is very good here too 😍

address: 269A Nguyễn Trãi, Cầu Ông Lãnh, Hồ Chí Minh 700000, Việt Nam
review_text: It's Pho restaurant. I had chicken Pho, then was good enough. The noodle is thin and soup was really good. They have chicken and also beef Pho. I thought their main was chicken, but not sure. Next time, if I have a chance the I'll try beef one. Anyway it was good enough.

address: 269A Nguyễn Trãi, Cầu Ông Lãnh, Hồ Chí Minh 700000, Việt Nam
review_text: - Restaurant: it has two floors. The first floor is air-conditioned, but the second floor only has fans, no air conditioning. - Service: Polite and friendly. - Food: Okay. - Price: Okay. I went to Pho Hien for dinner with my family. Since the first floor was full, we were directed to the second floor. However, the restaurant didn't turn on the air conditioning on the second floor, only the fans, so it was very hot. We turned on all the fans, but it was still very hot, which made me feel uncomfortable while eating. As for the Pho, the soup was delicious, and the accompanying vegetables were fresh. However, the meat was a bit too tough.

address: 7 Lý Chính Thắng, Xuân Hòa, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Wanted to write a review as some seem pretty mixed and maybe people aren't aware of the significance. Tasty pho, simple broth and a range of garnishes. Clean, not greasy and fresh. Nice owner and cute dog too. The secret to this place is only if you ask to see upstairs, note there is a small donation.

address: 7 Lý Chính Thắng, Xuân Hòa, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Quite good for me, hope this Pho can have more clients.

address: 7 Lý Chính Thắng, Xuân Hòa, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Decent Pho in ok atmosphere. Owner(s) were watching tv in the meantime and occasional motorbike is being driven inside to park there

address: 7 Lý Chính Thắng, Xuân Hòa, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: "Pho Binh * broth not noteworthy. only 2 herbs offered. 70k for tai nam, I'm sure I was overcharge due to not understanding the old man when he told me the price, but if 70k is their price, it's way too much. Small bowl. Basic/generic chili sauce. I'll never return." Go here at your own risk.

address: 7 Lý Chính Thắng, Xuân Hòa, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: This place sucked! Owner was very rude and overcharged us for the pho. Never ever coming back here. Would leave 0 stars if I could 😂

address: 31 Đ. Hải Triều, Sài Gòn, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Lousy food at noisy area. Quite surprise with the relatively high rating! Expensive, mainly to trap tourists around Nguyen Hue Waliking Street. Stuffy, dusty & dirty environment. Street kiosk standard in disguise as a restaurant. Service so so. Not worth the 2nd look!

address: 31 Đ. Hải Triều, Sài Gòn, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: I do not recommend this place. We found many bugs in our food. We asked them to change our dish for another one and the same thing happened another bug appeared. We just wanted a refund after and they just gave us an attitude.

address: 31 Đ. Hải Triều, Sài Gòn, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Amazing pho（so tasty that I finished before taking photo ）! yummy porridge! Nice staff! best street food in HCM!

address: 31 Đ. Hải Triều, Sài Gòn, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Hot day calls for chicken porridge. Visited place after having so much heavy Vietnamese food. They served chicken pho, porridge and other notable Vietnamese cuisines.

address: 31 Đ. Hải Triều, Sài Gòn, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: The chicken broth for quality here was good, as what I was saying. Very busy environment, a few locals eating here, open 24/7, so expect it to get busy. For me, it wasn’t definitely my favourite pho as the noodles were very thin, same as the chicken, but the soup broth was still very good — a bit less on the salty side, a bit more clean and refreshing.

restaurant_name: Phở Việt Nam by Võ Quốc
address: 72/1 Trần Quốc Toản, Xuân Hòa, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: This pho seems to be a trendy place. Pho is ok. Nothing special. Staff is overloaded. The positive point is the restaurant is located in a nice villa (old house of Nguyễn Thiện Nhân former chairman of HCMC people’s committee) so you feel like eating in a garden.

restaurant_name: Phở Việt Nam by Võ Quốc
address: 72/1 Trần Quốc Toản, Xuân Hòa, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: The pho is is pretty standard, not the worst but not amazing. The cleanliness of this store isnt the best. I found a bug near the sauces and the table wasnt wiped prior to seating us. When we asked the staff to clean the table, they acknowledged us but didnt do it.

restaurant_name: Phở Việt Nam by Võ Quốc
address: 72/1 Trần Quốc Toản, Xuân Hòa, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: I genuinely love the phở here, as well as the bún bò Huế. I gave the restaurant a 5-star rating because the broth for the phở is cooked to such a clear, refined, and delightful flavor. Everything is truly wonderful, and I’ve returned to eat here many times. I just have a small suggestion: I hope the staff can be a bit quicker and more agile in their service. The serving process could be more professional and faster. As for the food, there’s nothing to debate—you really are culinary experts.

restaurant_name: Phở Việt Nam by Võ Quốc
address: 72/1 Trần Quốc Toản, Xuân Hòa, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: This is my dad's favorite place for phở and given how much of this dish he's eaten over the years, I would say that a pretty credible endorsement. I'm not a phở person at all but I have to admit the phở lõi rùa (pho with beef's rare turtle cut) here is good. The broth is impressively clear and light, closer to what you would find in the North. The noodles were flat and wider than what you usually find, giving a silkier mouthfeel and allowing them to hold onto more broth. The beef was a bit overcooked for me but still decently tender with ribbons of tendon adding a nice crunchy texture. For dipping sauce, chef Võ Quốc has his homemade chili sauce and his own brand of fish sauce and hoisin sauce at every table. The chili sauce is tangier than what Vietnamese are used to, closer to Sriracha than our beloved Cholimex/Chinsu (also available at every table).

restaurant_name: Phở Việt Nam by Võ Quốc
address: 72/1 Trần Quốc Toản, Xuân Hòa, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Good taste!!! PHO is perfect! Clean and kindly 💯💯💯 I like this restaurant🇻🇳

address: 122/10/3 Trần Đình Xu, Cầu Ông Lãnh, Hồ Chí Minh 70000, Việt Nam
review_text: Very flavourful pho of a proud owner for very cheap. We loved the street ambiance in an alley so there was no chaos from people or cars. Lots of complimentary herbs. The owner is kind and passionate. We are even planning to go back there.

address: 122/10/3 Trần Đình Xu, Cầu Ông Lãnh, Hồ Chí Minh 70000, Việt Nam
review_text: Cam On Bac! Most authentic Pho, but also most authentic place to eat a high quality pho! On the streetside, for a cheap price and the owner is not into making money but to make people happy with his food! This place with this heartful owner deserves so much more attention and i love that even when we tried to tip him and he knew we are tourists, he just wanted us to come back and eat his food again 🥰 I can confirm, that even if its a side street restaurant the food was safe to eat and i had no worries. Lets make him make more happy people!

address: 122/10/3 Trần Đình Xu, Cầu Ông Lãnh, Hồ Chí Minh 70000, Việt Nam
review_text: One of the best pho’s around that I’ve tried. Best value for money here for sure. In a nice little alley so its not crazy loud and polluted while eating.

address: 122/10/3 Trần Đình Xu, Cầu Ông Lãnh, Hồ Chí Minh 70000, Việt Nam
review_text: Perhaps one of my favourite bowls of pho during my whole trip to Vietnam. Popular with locals, great rich, flavoursome pho. All the condiments and herbs you’d want. Highly recommend anyone to go.

address: 122/10/3 Trần Đình Xu, Cầu Ông Lãnh, Hồ Chí Minh 70000, Việt Nam
review_text: Really nice pho, as I said to chief, it's better than in a "restaurant"! It's on the street, but it's the atmosphere of Vietnam 🙂

address: 212/7 Nguyễn Văn Nguyễn, Tân Định, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Finally, after several years of living in the neighbourhood, I was able to wake up in the morning and come to this cafe 😄 The soup is really very tasty and rich, the broth is cool. The portion is small, it's good for breakfast, you won't feel heavy from eating. A great cafe with soup if you wake up before lunch and need breakfast.

address: 212/7 Nguyễn Văn Nguyễn, Tân Định, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: A small eatery with super authentic and tasty pho! The owners were very friendly too. Would come back if I’m in HCM again.

address: 212/7 Nguyễn Văn Nguyễn, Tân Định, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Super hearty and delicious bowl of pho. Perfect way to start the day. 50,000 dong per bowl.

address: 212/7 Nguyễn Văn Nguyễn, Tân Định, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Visiting the eatery because the charming old-time ambiance that might evoke nostalgia, but the food itself was not impressive. The pho broth, unfortunately, leans towards the sweet side, lacking a depth of flavour. The toppings also seem a bit skimpy for the price. Despite having four family members cooking and serving, there appears to be a lack of coordination, making them seem overwhelmed even when it is not particularly busy.

address: 212/7 Nguyễn Văn Nguyễn, Tân Định, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Nice little pho restaurant with an old skool vibe. The pho was ok, with the broth being a bit sweet and mild of taste. The spice sauces added some extra kick. Portion is not enormous, but that’s the same for the price of a bowl: 45k.

address: 7 Nguyễn Thái Bình, Bến Thành, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: It’s a type of street food so don’t hold fine dining expectation here. Food: i love eating beef stripe, cartilage, and it’s hard to find a pho place with them in hcmc. In term of broth, i find this place is not as a strong flavor, kinda plain. Stripe and cartilage here is good and it’s what i am here for. Service: they serve you food and that’s all. Nothing fancy or outstanding. It’s decently clean. Atmosphere: street vendor.

address: 7 Nguyễn Thái Bình, Bến Thành, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: I ordered a deluxe combination with egg noodle. It was worth to try. Not too many tables, so you may have to wait if you go there during busy time.

address: 7 Nguyễn Thái Bình, Bến Thành, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: I loved this Phở! The broth was rich and peppery, the meat was fatty (wagyu style kind of), there was tripe... Everything that I love! The venue and the service was nothing special. The pricing is a bit higher and the bowl is not bigger than other places. But the quality of the meat and broth made up for it. All in all, I was happy! Highly recommended!

address: 7 Nguyễn Thái Bình, Bến Thành, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: A popular spot among locals. The restaurant is open-air, so it can get a bit hot. One of the highlights is that you can customize your noodles and toppings just the way you like. It’s affordable, with quick service and a steady flow of customers, especially during lunchtime. Personally, I love their wide, flat pho noodles — so satisfying!

address: 7 Nguyễn Thái Bình, Bến Thành, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: The broth is the best in HCMC, rich and flavorful. The beef is tender yet pleasantly chewy, and the pho noodles are thicker and wider than usual. Be sure to add the spicy chili sauce, you’ll be sweating as if you’ve just come out of a sauna. Enjoy!

address: 258 Vĩnh Viễn, Vườn Lài, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Good food with staff. The food is served quite quickly, but the surrounding is a bit old as it seems the place had been built long without any renovations.

address: 258 Vĩnh Viễn, Vườn Lài, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Omg you must eat this. Good portion and tender beef!

address: 258 Vĩnh Viễn, Vườn Lài, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: That was the best pho I have ever had. And I felt like was very welcomed in this place

address: 258 Vĩnh Viễn, Vườn Lài, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Good for a full-belly fill up, esp late night ventures. Prices are a-okay with plenty of options to choose from.

address: 258 Vĩnh Viễn, Vườn Lài, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Good prices.....

address: 281/62 Đ. Lý Thường Kiệt, Phú Thọ, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Very authentic bowl of phở. The whole set up is amazing, clean utensils, separate counter for dipping sauce and condiments. Still a bit hot, but can’t complain because of the heat wave.

address: 281/62 Đ. Lý Thường Kiệt, Phú Thọ, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Pho broth was good, the bean sprouts were refillable, the amount of beef was also for me bit a lot. Overall, good pho.

address: 281/62 Đ. Lý Thường Kiệt, Phú Thọ, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Food: This is a pretty good quality bowl of pho that tastes good, but to me it's a bit too sweet, I've had it for the 3rd time Space: comfortable, airy, spacious Price: Suitable for many audiences Service: fast ordering, free viewing Note: no Return: yes nhanbdsreview

address: 281/62 Đ. Lý Thường Kiệt, Phú Thọ, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: My first place to eat pho in Vietnam, taken by a friend who loves it, I would definitely go there again

address: 281/62 Đ. Lý Thường Kiệt, Phú Thọ, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Should try the Pho at this restaurant. It's clean and delicious.

restaurant_name: Phở Việt Hưng| Phở Ngon Lê Văn Sỹ | Phở Ngon Tân Bình |
address: 307 Đ. Lê Văn Sỹ, Tân Sơn Hòa, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Best Pho in all of Vietnam! Stumbled upon this place and what a gem!!! This Pho had the most depth and authentic flavor, speaking to the restaurant’s years of tradition. It was a nice to have but not expected, that it was also the cleanest street food spot of all the places we went to in Saigon. We highly highly recommend this place.

restaurant_name: Phở Việt Hưng| Phở Ngon Lê Văn Sỹ | Phở Ngon Tân Bình |
address: 307 Đ. Lê Văn Sỹ, Tân Sơn Hòa, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Just deliciousssss ! Definitely one of the best pho I've ever had in Saigon. Will come back for sure !

restaurant_name: Phở Việt Hưng| Phở Ngon Lê Văn Sỹ | Phở Ngon Tân Bình |
address: 307 Đ. Lê Văn Sỹ, Tân Sơn Hòa, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: The broth is so delicious. Beef is tender and juicy. The noodles are so soft. Pho is served with bean sprout, herbs and sauces. The taste is very excellent. Should eat with beef balls. One bowl is enough for one person, but for me, it's still not enough because with this price, other places will served with a bigger proportion 🙂 One bowl here costs 60k. I think can eat here, everything was good

restaurant_name: Phở Việt Hưng| Phở Ngon Lê Văn Sỹ | Phở Ngon Tân Bình |
address: 307 Đ. Lê Văn Sỹ, Tân Sơn Hòa, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Vietnamese food - Japanese perfection! Really nice and appetizing Vietnamese food. Delicious dishes with very fresh vegetables, cooked in a really neat and clean kitchen. Thank you.

restaurant_name: Phở Việt Hưng| Phở Ngon Lê Văn Sỹ | Phở Ngon Tân Bình |
address: 307 Đ. Lê Văn Sỹ, Tân Sơn Hòa, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Always like to pop by this Pho shop whenever I came HCM. Love the shop lighting and the place look bright and clean. Love their broth very much, it looks light but the taste is very flavourful. The ingredients used are also fresh. Do pop by this shop if you are in HCM. I paid 60k for the Pho👍😊

address: 68 Đ. Lê Đức Thọ, Hạnh Thông, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Absolutely delicious! Pho was rich with flavour and the brisket slow cooked to perfection. Friendly trustworthy staff who made the experience worthy of repeating. Thank you!

address: 68 Đ. Lê Đức Thọ, Hạnh Thông, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: The place is clean. They have nice “Phở” (famous Vietnamese white noodle). The foods are great at reasonable price for it quality. Car parking are limited available front of the place. Staff are helpful

address: 68 Đ. Lê Đức Thọ, Hạnh Thông, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Food was nice had pho 🍲 7/10

address: 68 Đ. Lê Đức Thọ, Hạnh Thông, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Food was sub par. The prices were alright but it’s very crowded and the food was bland. However, good for a quick meal if you’re not too fussed about your food

address: 68 Đ. Lê Đức Thọ, Hạnh Thông, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Ly Quoc Su Go Vap is one of the franchise of The famous Hanoi Ly Quoc Su Pho brand. I have tried the pho in Hanoi and the pho of the southern franchise is actually not bad at all, the taste is really good and lots of meat. Especially they have northern chilli sauce which bring a very big different from the southern Pho. The restaurant is clean and good service! Highly recommend!

address: 160 Pasteur, Quận 1, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: What an experience. The vast array of flavours and lime and just all round enjoyable food. Quick service and quick to table. No complaints. Definitely worth visiting for a meal. Great value. $45 aud per person for drinks and plenty of food.

address: 160 Pasteur, Quận 1, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Mình biết đến quán Ngon Pasteur từ hơn 10 năm trước. Lúc đó quán còn được sơn bằng màu Vàng colonial. Quán nổi tiếng chuyên món thuần Việt của 3 miền Bắc Trung Nam Việt Nam. Tuy nhiên vì là Restaurant ngay trung tâm nên giá sẽ cao hơn mặc bằng chung. Bù lại món ăn tại quán rất ngon và được bày trí bài bản. Dịch vụ tại quán tất nhiên cũng rất tốt. Quán sẽ phù hợp với những bạn yêu món Việt và khách nước ngoài muốn thưởng thức món ăn Việt Nam với giá cả chấp nhận được só với những Reataurant khác tại trung tâm Sài Gòn. Mình đặc biết thích món chề Sân Xa Hạt Lựu, làn nào tới Ngon mình cũng phải gọi 1 ly.

address: 160 Pasteur, Quận 1, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Major tourist trap with 65k small water bottle lol. It’s OK I guess because we’re paying for the aesthetic. somewhat of a kitschy Las Vegas larger than life type vibe but tropical. The whole place was fun. I like it and should probably come with a group next time. Not really a place you go alone . Coffee is strong!

address: 160 Pasteur, Quận 1, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: I have being tongon restaurant during my short stay at Ho Chi Minh City.This place is really busy with both locals and foreigners. Th y do serve all authentic Vietnam dishes as well as vegetarian dishes. Food taste is reatgood and insid atmosphere is well maintained. Color combinations, action stations created a different vibe. Service level of the staff is really good and they are friendly. However if you are visiting during peak times you may need to wait to get a seating due to high demand.

address: 160 Pasteur, Quận 1, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Referral by local. Business was good in dinner time on Sat. The decoration is impressive but eating outdoor without air conditioning will be a challenge in daytime. They provided fusion Vietnamese food. I get lost whole reading the menu as there are more than 100 photos of food and another 200 of drinks. Food quality is up to standard but a bit salty and tasted they put quit amount of msg for seasoning. The mango rice as dessert was best that I can recommend.

address: 10 Đặng Tất, Tân Định, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Mình có dịp dùng bữa tại Cục Gạch Quán và hiểu vì sao nơi đây luôn được nhiều người giới thiệu khi muốn thưởng thức ẩm thực Việt truyền thống. Ngay từ lúc bước vào đã cảm nhận được không gian rất đặc biệt, mang nét hoài cổ với nhiều đồ vật xưa, cây xanh và cách bài trí gần gũi như một ngôi nhà Việt cũ. Không khí yên tĩnh, ấm cúng, rất phù hợp để đi cùng gia đình hoặc tiếp bạn bè từ xa đến. Thực đơn khá phong phú với nhiều món ăn mang hương vị quen thuộc của bữa cơm gia đình Việt. Mình gọi một vài món đặc trưng và đều cảm thấy nguyên liệu tươi, nêm nếm vừa miệng, giữ được hương vị truyền thống nhưng vẫn tinh tế. Các món được mang lên khá nhanh, trình bày đẹp mắt và khẩu phần phù hợp để nhiều người cùng thưởng thức. Một điểm cộng nữa là đội ngũ nhân viên rất lịch sự và chu đáo. Dù nhà hàng khá đông khách nhưng mọi người vẫn phục vụ nhanh nhẹn, thường xuyên quan tâm xem khách có cần hỗ trợ gì thêm hay không. Từ khâu đón khách đến lúc thanh toán đều diễn ra chuyên nghiệp và tạo cảm giác thoải mái. Nếu muốn tìm một nhà hàng mang đậm nét Việt Nam để thưởng thức bữa ăn ngon trong không gian nhiều cảm xúc thì Cục Gạch Quán là lựa chọn rất đáng trải nghiệm. Đây chắc chắn là địa điểm mình sẽ quay lại và cũng sẵn sàng giới thiệu cho bạn bè mỗi khi có dịp đến TP. Hồ Chí Minh.

address: 10 Đặng Tất, Tân Định, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Set in a pretty green lush house, the atmosphere is welcoming. I was solo dining and didn’t want to over order. I’m glad that I told the waiter I didn’t want to eat fatty pork so he suggested a dish with leaner cut.. The morning glory with flower stir fry was amazing. Loved that dish! I could not finish my food so they kindly packed it up for me. I’m so happy because I didn’t waste any food and I enjoyed my dining experience there.

address: 10 Đặng Tất, Tân Định, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Grrat service clean and tidy. Fresh Rice and squid dish ,fried tofu was excellent. Crab was a underwhelming and small and not special, the one dish disappointed the whole meal . I expected alot more. Odd the the rice bowls are chipped and cracked, poor hygiene.

address: 10 Đặng Tất, Tân Định, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Wow. What a exceptional surprise this place turned out to be. The food is phenomenal. I want to say that they keep it simple, but it would be an understatement to the purity and elegance that the chef treats the cuisine of their home country. This place is first and foremost a true experience to Vietnamese cuisine. The traditional background music to the decor emanates the splendor of what Vietnam has to offer. I was not ready for how impressive the dishes would be or how accurately they would capture the essence of traditional home cooking here. The prices are more in line with elevated comfort and worth every bit. The menu leaves your meal open to your interpretation. Every vegetable, is available to your style of preparation. All proteins are available in various ways. There is a full assortment of desserts and drinks. I recommend making a reservation, as the popularity is evident and securing a table in a timely manner quickly becomes competitive. It is not an exaggeration to say that this place is a must try for visitors to the Saigon area. The quality is stunning.

address: 10 Đặng Tất, Tân Định, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Cục Gạch Quán has a really nice homey feel. It felt like we stepped into a traditional Vietnamese house rather than a restaurant. The space is warm, rustic, and comfortable, with a relaxed vibe that makes you want to slow down and enjoy the meal. Food is simple but very well done, full of classic Vietnamese flavours.

address: 59 Hồ Xuân Hương, Xuân Hòa, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Lúc trước có ăn nhà hàng này một lần khá vừa ý nên hôm nay dẫn người quen tới ăn. 19h30 ngày 21/05/2026. Tổng cộng 6 người. --------- Điểm cộng: Cơm trắng, nghêu kho tộ, cá bông lau kho tộ ngon. Bông bí xào tỏi, nước chanh muối ngon. --------- Điểm trừ: - Cơm niêu (đập nồi đất) cơm cháy cứng, khó ăn. - Món xào chay cứng ngắc, ko ăn được. (Hình 1) - Canh chua cá bông lau rất chua, khó ăn. (Hình 2) - Tôm sốt CỰC KỲ MẶN. Nước sốt mặn chát, vớt tôm ăn cũng dở vì tôm thấm muối mặn chát. (Hình 2) Khi mình phản ánh, nhân viên mặc áo đen trả lời "Lần sau anh, chị nói trước là ăn theo khẩu vị miền Tây." (!?) Mình nói đây là lỗi bỏ muối quá tay chứ 3 miền Bắc Trung Nam ko có miền nào ăn mặn chát tới như vậy. Trên bàn có 2 món nghêu kho tộ với cá kho tộ đáng lẽ là 2 món mặn nhất trong bữa ăn thì lại rất vừa ăn, ko bị mặn. Trong khi đó món tôm sốt lại cực kỳ mặn. Vậy chỉ có thể là do món tôm sốt bị lỗi bỏ muối quá tay chứ ko thể đổ thừa do khẩu vị vùng miền. Tưởng đã thông, một lát sau nhân viên áo đen lặp lại "Lần sau anh, chị nhớ nói trước là ăn theo khẩu vị miền Tây." (!?) Mình lặp lại một lần nữa như trên. Ai cũng có thể có sai sót. Sai thì nhận sai, sửa sai để tiến bộ. Đó là chuyện rất bình thường. Còn cứ giữ thái độ trả treo với khách "do khẩu vị vùng miền" thì nhà hàng này sớm muộn sẽ dần mất khách. Sẽ ko quay lại chỗ này.

review_text: Trải nghiệm cá nhân thì đồ ăn bình thường, giá hơi cao so với chất lượng nhưng không gian rất ấm cúng, sang trọng

address: 59 Hồ Xuân Hương, Xuân Hòa, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: 📍 Địa chỉ: Nhà hàng Cơm Niêu Sài Gòn (có các cơ sở tại 59 Hồ Xuân Hương & 27 Tú Xương, Quận 3, TP. HCM) 🕐 Giờ mở cửa: khoảng 06:00 – 23:00 / 10:00 – 22:00 tùy chi nhánh 🍽️ Giá tham khảo: ~200 k – 300 k/người ⭐ Đánh giá trung bình: ~4.2–4.3⭐ (đa số review tích cực) Cơm Niêu Sài Gòn là một trong những địa chỉ ẩm thực Việt truyền thống nổi tiếng tại Sài Gòn, tồn tại gần 30 năm với mong muốn giữ gìn hương vị mỗi miền và đem cảm giác “cơm nhà” vào bàn ăn phố thị. 👍 Điểm tốt – What’s Great 🍲 1. Hương vị Việt truyền thống, đa dạng món Nhà hàng phục vụ nhiều món Việt quê nhà + cơm niêu truyền thống như cơm cháy, cá kho tộ, canh chua, bún bò Huế, phở bò / gà và nhiều món mặn khác. Hương vị đậm đà, nêm vừa miệng giúp bạn cảm nhận “món ngon như cơm nhà” – điều mà không phải nhà hàng nào cũng làm được ở mức ổn. 🍚 2. Đặc sản cơm niêu mới lạ và hấp dẫn Một trong những trải nghiệm đáng nhớ ở đây là niêu cơm đất – cơm nấu trong niêu đất nóng dẻo thơm được phục vụ nóng hổi, kèm cá kho, thịt kho, rau luộc và nước chấm gia truyền. Đây là điểm nhấn độc đáo khiến nhiều thực khách nhớ mãi. 🏡 3. Không gian thoáng & phong cách Việt Nam xưa Một số cơ sở có kiến trúc mang phong cách hoài cổ, có sân vườn hay nhà cổ – cực kỳ thích hợp cho bữa ăn gia đình, tụ họp bạn bè hoặc tiếp khách. 🌏 4. Phù hợp khách trong nước & quốc tế Nhà hàng là điểm dừng chân nổi tiếng không chỉ với người Việt mà cả du khách quốc tế mỗi khi đến Sài Gòn, giúp họ khám phá các món đặc trưng ba miền trong một địa điểm duy nhất. 👨‍🍳 5. Phục vụ chuyên nghiệp, bữa ăn trọn vẹn Phần lớn review khen nhân viên thân thiện, phục vụ nhanh và đồ ăn đem ra nóng sốt — nhất là món cơm niêu và cá kho tộ, tạo cảm giác ấm áp như bữa gia đình. ⚠️ Điểm chưa tốt – What Could Be Better 💸 1. Giá hơi cao với món truyền thống So với quán ăn bình dân, giá ở đây thường rơi vào mức trung đến cao hơn chút (~200 k–300 k/người), khiến một số thực khách cảm thấy không quá rẻ nếu so với các quán cơm niêu đường phố. 📣 2. Mức độ đồng đều món ăn có lúc khác nhau Mặc dù phần lớn review đánh giá tích cực, nhưng vẫn có những nhận xét cho rằng một vài món (như món canh hay một số kiểu kho) không tạo “wow” mạnh như kỳ vọng, đôi khi có cảm giác hơi quen miệng hơn là gây ấn tượng sâu sắc. 🪑 3. Không gian đông & chỗ ngồi có thể ồn Vì là điểm đến rất được yêu thích, vào giờ cao điểm (trưa / tối cuối tuần) không gian có thể đông và hơi ồn, nên nếu bạn thích ăn yên tĩnh thì cần chọn giờ đi sớm hoặc đặt bàn trước. 📍 4. Một số trải nghiệm phục vụ không đồng đều Dù nhân viên nhìn chung tận tình, một vài review hiếm phản ánh thái độ phục vụ chưa luôn nhất quán, đặc biệt ở một vài ca đông khách. 👤 Ai phù hợp với Cơm Niêu Sài Gòn ✔️ Người muốn khám phá ẩm thực Việt truyền thống đa dạng từ Bắc – Trung – Nam trong một nơi. ✔️ Gia đình, người lớn tuổi, nhóm bạn tụ họp vì không gian thoáng, món dễ ăn và menu phong phú. ✔️ Du khách quốc tế muốn thưởng thức cơm niêu + đặc sản Việt trong không gian thanh lịch. ✔️ Ai thích trải nghiệm ẩm thực truyền thống với phong cách hiện đại hơn quán bình dân. 🚫 Ai không phù hợp ❌ Người ưu tiên đồ ăn cực rẻ / quán bình dân – vì giá ở đây không thuộc loại rẻ nhất so với quán ăn vỉa hè. ❌ Người tìm trải nghiệm tinh tế đẳng cấp fine‑dining – Đây là ẩm thực truyền thống được nâng tầm, không phải phong cách cao cấp Michelin. ❌ Ai chỉ thích ăn nhanh nhỏ lẻ – vì không gian và cách phục vụ phù hợp bữa ăn trọn vẹn hơn là “ăn vội”. ✍️ Tóm lại Cơm Niêu Sài Gòn là một trong những địa chỉ ẩm thực Việt truyền thống đáng thử ở Sài Gòn, mang lại cảm giác ấm, đầy đặn và gắn kết như cơm nhà — đặc biệt với món cơm niêu đất, cá kho tộ, cơm cháy giòn rụm và đa dạng món ba miền. Dù giá có hơi trên mức bình dân và không gian đôi lúc hơi ồn vào giờ cao điểm, đây vẫn là lựa chọn tuyệt vời cho bữa ăn gia đình, gặp gỡ bạn bè hoặc tiếp vị khách nước ngoài khi muốn khám phá hương vị Việt trái tim.

address: 59 Hồ Xuân Hương, Xuân Hòa, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Những ai đi khám ở bệnh viện da liễu thì có thể ghé qua đây để ăn cơm. Nhà hàng mang phong cách nhẹ nhàng, ấm cúng. Rất thân thiện. Đồ ăn cũng giá khá tốt nhưng món salad có vẽ chưa được ổn cho lắm, khá chua với khẩu vị của mình.

address: 59 Hồ Xuân Hương, Xuân Hòa, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Cơm Niêu Sài Gòn là một địa điểm lý tưởng để thưởng thức hương vị cơm gia đình Việt Nam trong một không gian ấm cúng và mang đậm nét truyền thống. Quán được thiết kế giản dị nhưng tinh tế, với nội thất gỗ và những chi tiết trang trí mộc mạc, tạo cảm giác như đang dùng bữa tại một ngôi nhà Việt xưa. Món cơm niêu ở đây thực sự ấn tượng, với cơm chín vừa tới, dẻo thơm, phần cháy giòn vàng rộm và rất vừa miệng. Các món ăn kèm đa dạng, từ cá kho tộ, thịt kho hột vịt, canh cua mồng tơi đến rau luộc chấm kho quẹt, tất cả đều được chế biến đậm đà, giữ được hương vị truyền thống. Mình đặc biệt thích món cá kho tộ, phần nước kho thơm và sánh, ăn kèm cơm cháy thì không thể cưỡng lại. Nhân viên phục vụ thân thiện, nhanh nhẹn và luôn sẵn sàng giới thiệu món ăn nếu cần. Giá cả ở mức hợp lý, rất đáng đồng tiền so với chất lượng món ăn và không gian. Đây là một địa điểm tuyệt vời để giới thiệu văn hóa ẩm thực Việt Nam đến bạn bè quốc tế hoặc đơn giản là để tìm lại hương vị quen thuộc của bữa cơm gia đình.

review_text: Không gian quán đẹp, ấm cúng và khá rộng rãi. Mình không ngờ ở trung tâm SG lại có không gian quán chill thế này. Về món ăn, bánh mì chấm sốt gạch ghẹ rất đậm vị, ăn rất cuốn. address: 31-33 Đặng Dung, Tân Định, Hồ Chí Minh 70000, Việt Nam
review_text: We spent the last night of our honeymoon in Vietnam here, and it was the perfect way to end our trip. The food was delicious, and the service was exceptionally attentive. We especially enjoyed the creative fusion of different cuisines in the dishes — that pho will stay in my heart forever haha. We also opted for the extra caviar, which was a lovely addition. We’d never had it with dessert before, but it worked surprisingly well with the sweet potato crème brûlée 👌🏻 It’s on the pricier side for Vietnam, but compared to Michelin restaurants we’ve visited before in Europe, it’s very affordable.

address: 31-33 Đặng Dung, Tân Định, Hồ Chí Minh 70000, Việt Nam
review_text: Every dish was a taste explosion - the interplay of warm and cold, the layering of spices, all perfectly balanced. The staff made it just as memorable: proactive, attentive, fluent in English and genuinely thoughtful about every request. A flawless evening from start to finish. Highly recommend. I recommend to plan at least minimum 2-3h for the whole experience.

address: 31-33 Đặng Dung, Tân Định, Hồ Chí Minh 70000, Việt Nam
review_text: We had such an amazing time at A by TUNG - the food and the service were both top notch. Definitely would recommend. Such bold, amazing flavors and beautiful presentation. So many interesting layers to each dish. And all the staff members were so kind and helpful❤️ so glad we got to try this place. Would definitely return next time!

address: 31-33 Đặng Dung, Tân Định, Hồ Chí Minh 70000, Việt Nam
review_text: From someone who has had multiple meals at 1 and 2 Michelin starred restaurants, i dare say this meal landed easily in my top 3 (probably 1st too). It introduced me to new flavour pairings and different ingredients that i didn’t even know of. Even got me eating stuff that i normally wouldn’t eat/dislike eating. Even my girlfriend who is super picky ate everything and found it good. The vibe was immaculate too and i really enjoyed the staff’s service. There were even mini activities packed into the meal that helped make the experience so much more special. Definitely returning to A by Tung every Vietnam trip from now onwards 💯

address: 31-33 Đặng Dung, Tân Định, Hồ Chí Minh 70000, Việt Nam
review_text: 🍊 Amazing dinner!! I don’t want to say too much cause you need to come and taste it for yourself. This 16 course meal is exquisitely prepared and every dish is incredibly delicious. It will blow your mind☺️ Give it a try if you’re ever in town!

address: 11a Ngô Văn Năm, Sài Gòn, Hồ Chí Minh 700000, Việt Nam
review_text: Mandarine Restaurant thực sự là một viên ngọc quý cho những ai yêu thích ẩm thực Việt Nam tinh tế và không gian sang trọng. Ngay khi bước vào, bạn sẽ bị ấn tượng bởi bầu không khí ấm cúng, được trang trí theo phong cách truyền thống Việt Nam đậm đà. Không gian nhà hàng được thiết kế tỉ mỉ với nội thất gỗ cổ điển, đèn lồng đỏ ấm áp, và các kệ trưng bày đồ gốm sứ tinh xảo . Các vách ngăn chạm khắc tinh tế tạo cảm giác riêng tư nhưng vẫn thông thoáng . Bàn ăn được set up vô cùng chuyên nghiệp với bát đĩa kiểu truyền thống và khăn ăn được gấp đẹp mắt, sẵn sàng đón tiếp thực khách. Điểm nhấn đặc biệt là chiếc đàn piano lớn sang trọng ở một góc , gợi ý về những buổi tối nhạc sống đầy lãng mạn. Thực đơn của nhà hàng hứa hẹn mang đến những món ăn Việt Nam đỉnh cao ("Finest Vietnamese Cuisine"). Dù chưa thưởng thức hết các món, nhưng cách trình bày và không gian đã cho thấy sự chăm chút kỹ lưỡng. Dịch vụ tại Mandarine rất ân cần và chuyên nghiệp. Nhân viên chu đáo và nhiệt tình, luôn sẵn sàng hỗ trợ thực khách. Đây là một địa điểm tuyệt vời cho những buổi hẹn hò lãng mạn, tiệc gia đình, hoặc tiếp đón đối tác quan trọng. Nếu bạn đang tìm kiếm một trải nghiệm ẩm thực Việt Nam đẳng cấp trong một không gian đậm chất văn hóa, Mandarine Restaurant chính là lựa chọn hoàn hảo. Chắc chắn tôi sẽ quay lại để thưởng thức thêm nhiều món ăn ngon ở đây.

address: 11a Ngô Văn Năm, Sài Gòn, Hồ Chí Minh 700000, Việt Nam

review_text: Quan Ngon is a pleasant spot for a relaxed Vietnamese dinner, especially if you enjoy traditional comfort food in homely Chinoise style setting without breaking your wallet. The restaurant is nicely decorated, with much of the outdoors vibrancy coming from the warm lantern lighting and inside, the Asian-chinoiserie interior décor. The space is open and well-ventilated (no fully enclosed walls), making it ideal for an evening meal. The overall vibe leans more towards comforting, homestyle Vietnamese food rather than luxurious or highly refined courses. There is seating available both upstairs and downstairs. A few interesting decorative features installed around the restaurant include a gold-white steel vintage motorbike, a rock statue, and a swing upstairs. Food-wise, the sour and spicy soup was satisfying and well balanced. The noodle portion was not overly heavy with a chewy qq texture. The meat in the soup was tender, soft, and lightly chewy, similar to well-cooked pho beef: supple, not dry, and easy to bite through while still having some body. The Vietnamese platters were decent overall (around a 6/10). The highlights were clearly the fried items, especially the fried beef-stuffed and vegetable-stuffed "popiahs" which were crisp and flavourful withoht being too oily. The "otak-otak" on the platter came with large lettuce and salad leaves for wrapping. The bún chả was well proportioned, with enough meat to properly accompany the noodles. I will recommend requesting extra lime/lemon as the set lacks an acidity source. Many dishes are assembly-based (similar to salads or DIY wraps) rather than fully integrated dishes like fried rice or pasta. This means the experience depends a lot on how much effort the diner puts into mixing and matching components. The mint served with the platters can sometimes be overpowering, particularly the larger leaves, which may dominate the overall flavour. The final bill for 2 dishes and 2 platters ended up around 650000 VNÐ, which is quite cheap actually :D

review_text: Quán cơm gà – cháo gà này nằm ngay mặt tiền đường Trương Công Định, rất dễ tìm. Không gian quán khá thoáng mát, sạch sẽ, bàn ghế gọn gàng. Có đợi một chút nhưng không lâu, hợp với mặt bằng quán bình dân. Về món ăn: Cháo gà là món mình ưng nhất — thơm, nóng, vừa vị, không bị loãng hay quá đặc; ăn vào cảm giác “ấm bụng” đúng chuẩn món cháo gà nhà làm. Gà xé mềm, ngọt thịt, không bị bở; phần muối chấm gà đặc biệt ngon, khiến mình — vốn ít khi chấm thịt — lần này lại chấm liên tục vì quá hợp vị. Gỏi gà nhiều, nêm nếm hợp lý; nước mắm đi kèm cũng rất đậm đà. Quán có combo 2 người giá 139k gồm 2 tô cháo và 1 dĩa gỏi, vừa đủ no, phù hợp cả giá tiền lẫn chất lượng. Với nhóm đi 2 người gọi gỏi nửa con thêm cháo hoặc cơm thì tầm 200k là ăn no nê. Một số lần thịt gà hơi dai nhẹ, nếu quán điều chỉnh đều tay hơn nữa thì sẽ hoàn hảo. So với mặt bằng khu vực, giá ở đây bình dân và hợp lý, lượng cháo khá nhiều; ai ăn ít nên dặn trước để quán giảm phần. Mình đã ghé nhiều lần vì gần cơ quan và lần nào cũng hài lòng: đồ ăn ổn định, sạch sẽ, mùi vị dễ chịu và rất hợp khẩu vị. Tổng kết: Quán gọn, sạch, giá tốt, món ngon — đặc biệt là cháo gà và muối chấm. Rất đáng thử và chắc chắn sẽ còn quay lại nhiều lần nữa.

review_text: We highly recommend experiencing Quince Saigon! We have been here eight months thus far and experienced many other great restaurants and majority of the Michelin rated ones, and this is definitely one of our top for so many reasons! The evening started in there ultra cool cocktail lounge that they have upstairs. It feels like it takes you back in time to an old Asian opium den, or some speakeasy! Beautifully designed, great selection of cocktails, and it’s an overall cool vibe. Then we made our way to dinner and we actual restaurant which has a completely different atmosphere and energy and a cool vibe within itself. Everybody was exceptionally welcoming and friendly, and it said a great tone for the night. One note we want to mention is that we have some diet restrictions and while many restaurants may accommodate them or make adjustments, the management at Quince went the extra mile and printed a customized menu with all the items that we could consume because they did not have pork or they were able to make adjustments. So I will say once again for the ultimate Dining experience and a wonderful night checking all the boxes with a great atmosphere, outstanding service and absolutely delicious food, this is a must!!! Also must mention they have a really wonderful wine list!!

review_text: Hẻm Hai Bà Trưng thì rất quen thuộc với mình vì trước mình học ở gần đây nên chiều nào cũng ghé qua ăn trước khi đi học thêm️️️ Cái đáng chú ý nhất khi ăn ở đây là nhìn vào đã thấy không hợp vệ sinh rồi, nhất là những ngày mưa trong hẻm ẩm thấp lắm, bàn ghế cũng thấp và chật chội, nên mình không ngồi lại mà mua về trường ngồi ăn. Chỗ này dơ nhưng mà mình ăn cả 3 năm cấp 3 thấy vẫn chưa bị đau bụng hay bị gì, nên dù nhìn dơ mình vẫn bấm bụng mạo hiểm ăn tiếp tại hơi ghiền đồ ăn trong này.. . Trước thì mình có ăn đủ thứ đồ ăn ở đây rồi, nhưng lần này về ăn trưa nên hàng quán chưa dọn ra như buổi chiều, đành vô trong ăn ốc. Mình siêu ghiền mì xào ốc ở đây, xào bơ tỏi nên ăn thơm và ngậy, có thêm rau muống giòn giòn nên ăn không bị mau ngán. Kèm với mì có nước nắm tỏi ớt pha ngọt để chan vào nếu mọi người thấy nhạt và muối ớt xanh để chấm ốc. Trước có một lần mình ăn mì xào sò sữa cũng ngon lắm nhưng mà bị cát hơi nhiều. Mì xào ốc giác thì ốc dai dai giòn giòn cũng ngon, nhưng mà đỉnh nhất với mình là ốc móng tay, thấy kết hợp ổn nhất với mì và rau muống.. . Tụi mình có gọi thêm sò điệp nướng mỡ hành, chem chép và ốc hương. Ốc hương với chem chép là được nấu sẵn để trong mấy cái chảo ở quầy ốc, lúc có người gọi thì làm nóng lại, nhưng tới khi bưng ra cho tụi mình thì vẫn nguội, ăn mất ngon một tí. Được cái bù lại là nêm nếm rất ngon nha, còn vì là hàng quán trong hẻm nên mình cũng không mong đợi là đồ tươi được, chất lượng cũng tạm ổn chứ không tệ. Chem chép có vài con chưa mở miệng nên ăn cũng hơi lo lo. Muối tiêu chanh chấm kèm rất ngon, kiểu như có thêm vị ngọt nhẹ nhẹ ấy.. . Sò điệp nướng mỡ hành ra sau mấy món trên, được nướng lúc mình gọi nên còn nóng. Món này thì có rưới sẵn nước mắm lên luôn nên không cần chấm, ăn rất vừa miệng.. . Lần này tụi mình vào hẻm ngồi nên phải mua nước. Trà tắc nhạt nhẽo lắm không chua không ngọt nên chỉ uống cho đỡ nóng và để có chỗ ngồi thôi. Và không phải khi nào cũng có đủ món như trên menu nên mọi người có gọi món thì nên hỏi trước luôn không còn món gì nước gì . . Tụi mình 3 người ăn hết chừng này là vừa no. Tất cả là 170.000, có nước là 10.000 mỗi ly, mì tầm 20.000, ốc là 20.000 tới 30.000, giá cả cũng chấp nhận được vì ở quận 1.. . Trưa thì có bán phở, canh bún, cơm gà chiên với ốc thôi, tầm 2 3 giờ chiều thì các quầy còn lại như kiểu bún bò, cơm thịt nướng, bánh bèo các thứ mới bắt đầu dọn ra nha. Hàng ốc thì đến tầm chiều cỡ 5 giờ là hết mì xào. Giá chung trong hẻm thì tầm 20.000 tới 30.000, phần ăn nhiều đảm bảo no.

Với mình món sò điệp sốt tiêu tương khá là mặn, nhưng do mình ăn nhạt quen nên với thị hiếu chung mình nghĩ vẫn phù hợp. Món sò điệp phủ trứng ngon hơn, ăn kèm với tương ớt và nước tương sẽ thổi lên hương vị cho món cơm. Đặc điểm chung là cả 2 đều dùng cơm chiên hơi khô, và sò điệp khoảng 4-5 con. Món hoành thánh hải sản chủ yếu là nhân tôm, vị khá tươi, hoành thánh chiên ráo dầu, giòn, ăn kèm với tương xí muội bắt miệng, nhưng không có gì đặc biệt. 📷 Về giá: 55k/ dĩa cơm theo mình là phù hợp. Với menu mình chụp bên dưới, mức giá này ở khu vực Bình Tân khá ổn, vừa túi tiền. ⚖️ Đánh giá chung: mình sẽ còn quay lại để thưởng thức thêm các món khác. Menu cùng cách nấu nướng, hương vị của món ăn đủ sức lôi cuốn thực khách quay lại nhiều lần nữa. Quán cực kỳ phù hợp cho gia đình, bạn bè ghé thăm cuối tuần, cũng như những người thích món Hoa như mình có dịp trở lại. ⭐️ Chấm điểm: 8/ 10 điểm. Đáng trải nghiệm.

restaurant_name: Anh Minh Quán - Quán ăn gia đình
address: 01R Đường số 10, Phú Lâm, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
review_text: Món ăn ở đây làm chỉn chu, ngon và bày trí cũng đẹp mắt. Mình đã thử cơm chiên tôm/hải sản phủ trứng, cơm gà xối mỡ và miến xào hải sản phủ trứng. Các món đều ngon, nêm nếm vừa vị. Hạt cơm rang tơi, ko quá dầu. Tôm/hải sản phủ trứng thì rất nhiều tôm và hải sản nha, rất chất lượng và tươi, ko như nhiều quán khác chỉ có vài miếng tôm cho có lệ. Đối với gà thì thịt gà mềm, vẫn mọng nước bên trong chứ ko khô, cứng. Bên ngoài thì lớp da gà giòn nhưng ko quá dầu, ko bị ngán. Mặc dù quán bán các món chiên xào nhưng bàn ghế, chén đũa rất sạch, ko bị nhớt dầu như quán CGGS gần đây mà mình đã ăn thử và sợ tới già. Món ăn ngon nhưng chất lượng chưa được đồng đều. Xuất hiện từ thế kỷ thứ 17, thời kỳ Hội An là 1 thương cảng sầm uất với sự giao thương của người Hoa và người Nhật. Món ăn là sự kết hợp tinh tế giữa nhiều nền ẩm thực nhưng trên hết vẫn giữ bản sắc Việt. Cái tên Cao Lầu xuất phát từ việc ngày xưa các thương nhân giàu có thường chọn ngồi trên các tầng cao để vừa thưởng thức món ăn, vừa ngắm nhìn phố phường. Quán @Vũ nằm trên mặt tiền 1 con đường tấp nập gần Ga Sài Gòn, quán tuy nhỏ nhưng sạch sẽ gọn gàng, có khoảng tầm 2-3 bàn, phục vụ cùng lúc tối đa mình nghĩ tầm 6-8 người. Làm theo anh hướng dẫn sẽ cảm nhận đc tất cả các hương vị trong chỉ 1 gắp mì. Độ dai sần sật của mì, vị đậm đà của thịt nạc xen lẫn chút mỡ, một chút tươi mát từ rau thơm và cải con, chút cay nhẹ của tương ớt Hội An, chua nhẹ từ chanh và giòn giòn từ da heo chiên. Tất cả hoà vào làm cho món ăn có 1 trải nghiệm thật đặc sắc 💯

Vì đây là lần đầu ăn cao lầu nên được anh chủ hướng dẫn chi tiết, từ việc uống miếng nước trước khi ăn, bỏ miếng ớt, vắt miếng chanh đến việc chỉ cách trộn & ăn sao cho đúng bài (mỗi muỗng ăn chung với mì, thịt & rau, mỗi 2-3 muỗng lại uống một ly nước). Sẽ giới thiệu quán đến bạn bè quay lại lần nữa để thưởng thức món mì Quảng. À mà bạn nào nhà gần, muốn đặt món thì cứ gọi anh chủ, ảnh ship đến cho thay vì đặt trễ app, đỡ tốn phí dịch vụ app. Và quán chỉ bán từ sáng đến 13h nha bà con.

review_text: English as below. Mình ko ở gần khu vực này. Tuy nhiên đã vô tình biết đến quán ăn này khoảng trước dịch Covid bùng nổ. Chủ quán rất hiểu về món ăn, tự tay làm. Cao lầu và Mỳ Quảng đều ngon. I don’t live near this area, but I happened to discover this restaurant before the COVID outbreak. The owner clearly knows the dishes well and makes everything by hand. The way they talk about and explain the food shows just how passionate they are about the flavors of their hometown. Both the Cao Lau and Mi Quang are delicious!

Thái độ xấc xược, mất lịch sự, không tôn trọng khách hàng. Trả tiền cũng ko cám ơn khách. Hay là vì mình hỏi món Mì sủi cảo thập cẩm đặc biệt mà ko ăn, hay là do mình ko gọi nước??? Ăn tô mì xong muốn ói ra trả lại cho quán. Từ lúc review quán ăn tới giờ chưa bao giờ viết như vậy cho đến khi gặp cái quán này.

review_text: Vị trí Nhà hàng nằm ở Tầng 5 của Vạn Hạnh Mall. Khu này tập trung rất nhiều nhà hàng xịn xò, nhưng Hoàng Yến thường nổi bật với không gian mở và decor kiểu ấm cúng, sang trọng. 2. Thực đơn (Buffet món Việt) Đặc trưng: Khác với kiểu lẩu Đài Loan như Manwah, ở đây chuyên về ẩm thực 3 miền Việt Nam. Menu cực kỳ đa dạng với hơn 60 món thay đổi theo ngày. Món nên thử: Hải sản: Tôm hùm (tùy gói buffet), ghẹ hấp, hàu nướng mỡ hành thường là những món "hết vèo" đầu tiên. Món truyền thống: Bánh xèo, bánh khọt, gỏi cuốn... làm rất chuẩn vị. Quầy đồ nướng: Thịt nướng, cá nướng được tẩm ướp đậm đà, ăn kèm với rau rừng rất dính. 3. Không gian & Phục vụ View: Nếu may mắn đặt được bàn gần cửa kính, mày sẽ có view nhìn xuống đường Sư Vạn Hạnh cực đẹp, nhất là vào buổi tối khi thành phố lên đèn. Phục vụ: Nhân viên ở đây khá chuyên nghiệp, dọn dĩa bẩn trên bàn rất nhanh để mày có chỗ lấy đồ mới. 4. Giá cả & Lưu ý Giá vé: Thường chia theo buổi trưa và buổi tối (buổi tối và cuối tuần giá cao hơn nhưng món ăn sẽ cao cấp hơn, có thêm hải sản xịn). Giá dao động tầm 350.000đ - 550.000đ/người. Lưu ý: Nên đặt bàn trước vì chi nhánh Vạn Hạnh Mall lúc nào cũng đông, đặc biệt là bàn view cửa sổ. Đừng ăn quá nhiều món khai vị (như súp hay bánh) ngay từ đầu, để dành bụng "chiến" hải sản và đồ nướng nhé.

address: 11 Sư Vạn Hạnh, Hòa Hưng, Hồ Chí Minh 720000, Việt Nam
review_text: Tôi và gia đình thường đến Buffet Hoàng Yến. Tổng thể đồ ăn luôn ngon, nóng, mới. Nhân viên rất thân thiện dễ thương phục vụ tận tình. address: 34 Võ Văn Tần, Xuân Hòa, Hồ Chí Minh 70000, Việt Nam
review_text: This is a truly Vietnamese restaurant with a modern style and a wide variety of delicious Vietnamese dishes. I think it would be a great place to bring friends, guests, or international visitors, and I believe everyone would enjoy the experience. The only downside is the price. It is around two to three times more expensive than similar Vietnamese restaurants. However, if you want to let your friends or guests experience it once or twice, I think it is very suitable. The restaurant is extremely well taken care of, with great attention to detail. It only has one floor, but there are separate indoor air-conditioned and outdoor areas, and each space has its own distinct atmosphere. Even the restroom is beautifully designed, with paintings featuring children from mountainous areas. There is also complimentary betel-leaf mouthwash, and instead of paper towels, they provide cloth towels for drying your hands. Throughout the restaurant, everything is very carefully arranged and taken care of, down to the spoons, bowls, glasses, and even the containers for chopsticks and spoons, which are carefully wrapped in banana leaves. The staff were very friendly and enthusiastic. The food menu is also quite special, featuring Vietnamese dishes from the North, Central, and South. The presentation is extremely detailed, cute, beautiful, and attractive. The drinks menu is also interesting, with different refreshing drinks, juices, and other options. We ordered an apricot, apple, and lemongrass drink, beer, and a ginger tea drink. My friend particularly enjoyed the apricot, apple, and lemongrass drink. There were four of us, and we ordered one hot pot, one platter of nem, and one portion of xôi gà tắm. That was already enough to make all four of us quite full. The total came to a little over 500,000 VND per person. The price is definitely higher than similar Vietnamese restaurants, but for a one- or two-time experience, I think it is very suitable and worthwhile, especially if you are bringing guests or international friends. Overall, I really enjoyed the attention to detail, the Vietnamese character, the food, and the service. 5 stars for me.

address: 34 Võ Văn Tần, Xuân Hòa, Hồ Chí Minh 70000, Việt Nam
review_text: I had a chance to visit this restaurant over the weekend and was quite impressed by the atmosphere and interior design. The space feels warm, relaxing and thoughtfully decorated with many beautiful corners throughout the restaurant. There is also a small souvenir area on the ground floor which is interesting to browse, although the prices are a bit higher compared to some other places. I ordered the dishes shown in the photos. I would highly recommend the shrimp fried rice flavorful, well-seasoned and definitely worth trying. The other dishes were a little mild in taste, based on my personal preference. Also, the Kumquat Blended drink has a slightly bitter taste so something to keep in mind if you are deciding what to order. The staff were very friendly, attentive and professional. Another plus point is that the restaurant is located near the War Remnants Museum making it a convenient stop for tourists after visiting the museum.

address: 34 Võ Văn Tần, Xuân Hòa, Hồ Chí Minh 70000, Việt Nam
review_text: Interesting menu, mixed service, lots of room for improvement. This was an interesting experience to say the least. The restaurant is a beautiful building but I would say that the experience went down from there. We sat inside which had a nice vibe. We had a few issues with our service in that our waiter didn’t speak English very well, he ended up accidentally charging our card the wrong amount so we had to pay in two separate checks, they weren’t very attentive and never checked in on us so we had to flag down someone else just to order a water. This was our most expensive restaurant in Vietnam so far and while the grilled duck 2 ways was excellent, however it didn’t come with any rice or anything to accompany it despite being almost 600k and we would have appreciated being told that to plan accordingly. This is definitely a meat heavy menu and interesting menu. We probably would have ordered more, salad, sides etc, but all had meat on them. I had the chicken fried rice which was lacking flavor and only had a few small pieces of chicken in it. The cocktails were good but the menu you doesn’t tell you which alcohol came with it, which should be fixed addressed. Also, the bathrooms were really bad for such a nice restaurant. Overall I think there is significant room for improvement for this restaurant but it has good potential.

address: 34 Võ Văn Tần, Xuân Hòa, Hồ Chí Minh 70000, Việt Nam
review_text: Today was my first visit to this place, and it has quickly become one of my favorite restaurants in Saigon. The food here is absolutely wonderful, inspired by traditional Vietnamese dishes from long ago, with a variety of fresh herbs, seasonings, spices, and incredibly fresh ingredients. The combination platter with the different pork dishes (including the pig's ears) and the veggies and herbs to wrap into the rice paper is an absolute must-try. So are all the salads, including the most scrumptious mango and fermented fish salad, or the papaya with beef jerky. All the other dishes around us looked insanely yummy as well. This is a place that I will probably come to on every single one of my visits to this beautiful city and mecca of food in the world: Saigon.

address: 34 Võ Văn Tần, Xuân Hòa, Hồ Chí Minh 70000, Việt Nam
review_text: My friend recommended me to try this restaurant as it is in the Michelin Guide and asked me to try making a reservation. Reservation wasn't difficult was able to get a table immediately on the date I wanted to do dinner. Took a taxi to the restaurant and was impressed by the architecture which looked pretty Gaudi inspired. There was the ground floor selling merchandise before we took the lift up to the 3rd floor where the restaurant was. Were being shown to the table with an interesting setup. Was seated in the terrace but it wasn't hot as it was raining before we arrived. Had a look at the menu and it looked pretty extensive so asked my local friend to recommend me the local dishes. He ordered a few and we waited less than 10 minutes thr food was all ready to be served. First the deep fried spring roll. Loved it, easily one of the best I have ever eaten. Complemented the sauce which was a little sour and very appetizing. The rest are all pretty interesting cause I have never seen them in Vietnamese cuisine before. The sour catfish soup was a surprise as I didn't expect it to taste that good and the catfish meat was fresh and firm. The soup tasted a bit like tom yam but it was so much better. The garlic pork jowl was pretty good. Was visually confused thought it was 2 big pieces but was nicely cut into pieces which also tasted similar to the Thai BBQ pork. The stir fried tonkin creeper with beef tasted quite good. Never tried this kind of vegetable before and loved the round bits which made the vegetables tasted crunchy. The sticky rice with chicken and wild mushroom, special dish which wowed me and was so delicious. Overall very impressive food, really very ignorant about Vietnamese cuisine until this meal how interesting it can be. Highly recommended and worth a pitstop in Ho Chi Minh and please make reservations to avoid disappointment.
